Transport Documents

Declaración de tránsito

A customs declaration or record for goods passing through a country’s territory in transit to another destination, required for regulatory control, security, and duty suspension.

Quick answer: A customs declaration or record for goods passing through a country’s territory in transit to another destination, required for regulatory control, security, and duty suspension.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Declaración de tránsito?

In this glossary, Declaración de tránsito refers to: A customs declaration or record for goods passing through a country’s territory in transit to another destination, required for regulatory control, security, and duty suspension.

How is Declaración de tránsito used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Las aduanas exigen una declaración de tránsito cuando las mercancías atraviesan un país intermedio según procedimientos internacionales."

Why does Declaración de tránsito matter in logistics?

Declaración de tránsito matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Declaración de tránsito?

Declaración de tránsito is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Declaración de tránsito belong to?

In this glossary, Declaración de tránsito is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A customs declaration or record for goods passing through a country’s territory in transit to another destination, required for regulatory control, security, and duty suspension.

Operational example

A transit entry is required by customs when goods move through an intermediate country under international transit procedures.

Localized term

Declaración de tránsito

Localized example

Las aduanas exigen una declaración de tránsito cuando las mercancías atraviesan un país intermedio según procedimientos internacionales.
